title: AOC / D3 LLM Cost and Tokens

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant

query.rawSql: select name as __text, tenant_id::text as __value from tenant order by name

list.definition: select name as __text, tenant_id::text as __value from tenant order by name

panels.title: Every currency figure on this dashboard is currently 1000x too high (gap G-02)

options.content:
`cost_engine` computes `(tokens / 1000) * input_cost_per_1k`, but `llm_pricing` stores the provider's **per-1M** prices in a column named per-1k. Verified to the digit: 34638 in + 927 out on gpt-4o-mini recorded 5.7519 USD where the truth is 0.0057519.

**Relative rankings are correct** — which model, which task type, which tenant dominates. **Absolute currency is not.** Until G-02 lands, treat the token panels as the trustworthy quantity: they are immune to the pricing bug.

**Never build a total-spend panel that UNIONs `execution_event` with `llm_usage_ledger`.** Their current disjointness is accidental — the graph ledger write path has never fired — and the union will double-count the moment it does.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1d') as time, provider_model as metric, sum(cost_usd) as value
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2
order by 1

select task_type, sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd, count(*) as calls
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by task_type
order by cost_usd desc

panels.title: Tokens in / out by model (trustworthy)
panels.description: Immune to the pricing bug. This is the quantity to reason about until G-02 lands.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1d') as time, provider_model || ' in' as metric, sum(input_tokens) as value
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2
union all
select $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1d') as time, provider_model || ' out' as metric, sum(output_tokens) as value
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2
order by 1

panels.title: Context bloat ratio (input : output)
panels.description: Currently 37.4:1 overall, with individual turns reaching 8305 in / 12 out. This is the earliest signal of runaway prompt cost and it moves before the spend chart does.

targets.rawSql:
select
  provider_model,
  task_type,
  sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens,
  sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens,
  round((sum(input_tokens)::numeric / nullif(sum(output_tokens), 0)), 1) as ratio
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2
order by ratio desc nulls last

panels.title: Spend by inference layer
panels.description: Separates real model spend from cache and SLM deflection. Only the graph path emits CACHE and SLM rows, so a ledger showing LLM only means layered inference is not being exercised on the live path.

targets.rawSql:
select inference_layer, count(*) as calls, sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by inference_layer
order by calls desc

panels.title: Pricing coverage gap
panels.description: Models with usage but no ACTIVE price. NOTE: cost is computed before the ledger row is written, so a pricing outage blocks the write entirely and cannot appear here. Treat an empty panel as inconclusive and cross-check the llm_pricing_not_found / llm_usage_not_recorded events on D1.

targets.rawSql:
select l.provider, l.provider_model, count(*) as calls, count(p.llm_pricing_id) as priced_rows
from llm_usage_ledger l
left join llm_pricing p
  on p.provider = l.provider and p.provider_model = l.provider_model and p.status = 'ACTIVE'
where $__timeFilter(l.occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or l.tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))
group by 1, 2
having count(p.llm_pricing_id) = 0
order by calls desc

panels.title: Cost attribution completeness
panels.description: The honesty panel. An empty cost-per-execution chart must read 'no linkage', not 'no cost'. llm_usage_ledger.flow_run_id and node_run_id are both 0/23 today because the agent write path hardcodes them to None and the graph write path has never fired. Cost per execution is structurally unavailable until gap G-08 is closed.

targets.rawSql:
select
  count(*) as ledger_rows,
  count(flow_run_id) as with_flow_run_id,
  count(node_run_id) as with_node_run_id,
  count(agent_run_id) as with_agent_run_id,
  count(session_id) as with_session_id,
  count(latency_ms) as with_latency_ms
from llm_usage_ledger
where $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  and ('${tenant:csv}' = '$__all' or tenant_id::text = any(string_to_array('${tenant:csv}', ',')))

panels.title: Live model call rate and latency (from spans)
panels.description: Span-derived, so it reflects the live path even where the ledger does not.

panels.title: Not measurable: cost per execution, time to first token

options.content:
- **Cost per execution (gap G-08).** `llm_usage_ledger.flow_run_id` and `node_run_id` are 0/23. The agent write path hardcodes both to `None`; the graph write path passes them but has never produced a row. The index `ix_llm_usage_ledger_flow_run_id` already exists, so this is a pure data-population problem with zero index work.
- **Time to first token (gap G-21).** `completion_start_time` is stamped *before* the provider call, so TTFT would report ~0 — silently wrong rather than absent. The OTel adapter accepts the argument for contract compatibility and deliberately drops it rather than record a false number.
